request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: A small colour change only: his skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, legs) becomes a little darker and greener, the green of a fresh pea pod, with a slightly darker green shadow; a mid-tone, not dark, not black, not yellow, the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather cap and goggles, straps and loincloth, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, gloves, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
